name: Ammihud
overview: Ammihud was a male member of the tribe of Naphtali, noted primarily as the father of Pedahel. His role is briefly mentioned in the context of the tribal lineage, with no additional personal details or narrative provided.
namesAndTitles: The name Ammihud means '[my] people have majesty,' reflecting a name of honor and significance. This proper name is not indicated to have been given directly by God but carries a meaningful Hebrew origin.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Ammihud as the father of Pedahel and as a descendant of Naphtali. Beyond this, there are no further family relationships detailed in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Ammihud's significance lies in his identification within the tribe of Naphtali and his role as the father of Pedahel. This connection situates him within the genealogical framework important for understanding tribal leadership and inheritance in Israel. Though his mention is brief, it contributes to the broader biblical record of God's people and their tribal structures.
